Brake system requirements¶

System Requirement: Braking distance SYS_001
status: approved
safety: C
satisfied by: PORT-BrakeCtrl-pBrakeReq
derives: AR_001
parent incoming: SYS_002, SYS_003

The vehicle shall stop within 40 m from 100 km/h.
System Requirement: Brake request latency SYS_002
status: approved
safety: C
satisfied by (unconfirmed): RUN-BrakeCtrl-BrakeRun
derives (unconfirmed): AR_001
parent: SYS_001

A brake request shall reach the actuator within 50 ms.
System Requirement: Brake light SYS_003
status: approved
safety: QM
satisfied by (unconfirmed): IF-IBrakeRequest
derives (unconfirmed): AS_001
parent: SYS_001

The brake light shall be on with every brake request.

Requirements from the requirements tool¶

The team’s requirements tool exports these as a needs.json of their own; their ids hold [.

System Requirement: Wheel slip detection SYS_REQ[12]
status: approved
safety: B
satisfied by: HW-BrakeEcu
parent incoming: SYS_REQ[13]

The system shall detect wheel slip during braking.
System Requirement: Wheel slip reaction SYS_REQ[13]
status: approved
safety: B
satisfied by: RUN-BrakeCtrl-BrakeRun
parent: SYS_REQ[12]

The brake request shall be reduced while a wheel slips.
System Requirement: Wheel slip warning [[SYS_REQ_14]]
status: approved
safety: A
satisfied by: HW-BrakeEcu

The driver shall be warned while a wheel slips.
